input: Hem the new suit trousers before the event

gold.taskTitle: Hem the new suit trousers before the event
gold.taskDescription: The user needs to get their new suit trousers hemmed in time for an upcoming event.

questions.title: When exactly is the event you need them for?
questions.description: Establish the deadline date to plan the hemming timeline.

questions.title: What is the current trouser length versus your ideal length?
questions.description: Understand how much fabric needs to be removed to achieve the correct fit.

questions.title: Will you hem them yourself or use a tailor?
questions.description: Determine whether this is a DIY task or requires booking a professional service.

questions.title: What type of fabric are the trousers made from?
questions.description: Fabric type affects the hemming method, thread choice, and difficulty level.

questions.title: Do the trousers need a specific hem style, such as cuffed?
questions.description: Identify whether a plain hem or a turn-up cuff finish is required.

questions.title: Do you already have the right shoes to measure the length against?
questions.description: Correct hem length depends on the heel height of the shoes being worn at the event.

questions.title: Do you have the necessary supplies at home to do this?
questions.description: Check whether thread, needles, pins, or a sewing machine are already available.
